reverie_dreams.page/basic/danmaku_tutori:
§eDanmaku§r refers to the bullet hell mechanic commonly seen in STG games, where dense projectiles form complex attack patterns.
In this mod, the same concept is applied.

Players can craft danmaku using the §eDanmaku Workbench§r with the following materials:

- Any Dye ×4
- Danmaku Core ×4
- Power ×35
- Point ×35
- Danmaku Template ×1

The §eDanmaku Template§r is used to define the shape of danmaku and is essential for crafting.
Right-click the template to design patterns in a pixel-grid style.

Different danmaku types have unique properties, but all can be upgraded at the §eEnhancement Table§r.

Upgrade materials:

- Iron Sword - Increase damage
- Slime Block - Increase projectile count
- Feather - Increase speed
- Spell Card Template - Modify trajectory
§aFumo§r refers to plush dolls produced by Gift, based on Touhou Project character designs by ANGELTYPE.
They are known for their sitting pose, iconic expression (ᗜˬᗜ), soft texture, and adorable chibi style.

In this mod, most Fumos can be obtained through expensive trades.
When placed, they face the player and support 16 directions. Right-clicking plays their sound.

Fumos can only be obtained from Fumo Traders, whose trades refresh daily.

Use a §bFumo License§r on a villager to turn them into a trader.
reverie_dreams.page/basic/gensokyo_altar:
The §eGensokyo Workbench§r is a key crafting block in this mod.
Most items are crafted using it.

It supports 9-slot recipes and requires a multiblock structure:

The surrounding pillars must be made of §eStripped Jomon Cedar§r, found in §aSavanna§r.
The top block must be blessed using paper.
Use shears to remove the blessing.

Once ready, use "empty hand + Shift + Right Click" to craft.
reverie_dreams.page/basic/getting_starte:
Reverie of Lost Dreams is a magic-adventure mod inspired by Touhou fanworks.

To begin, craft the §eGensokyo Altar§r, which allows crafting items like §eHourai Jewel Branch§r, §eGungnir§r, and §eHakurei Gohei§r.

- §ePower§r and §bPoint§r are basic materials dropped from mobs and fairies.

Explore further crafting recipes in this guide or via Polydex.
reverie_dreams.page/basic/role_and_partn:
§aPartners§r are companion entities similar to maids from Touhou Little Maid.

They can fight, work, carry items, and interact.
Feed them cake to tame.

Summon partners using character cards crafted at the §eGensokyo Workbench§r.

If a partner dies, they drop a §eData Card§r.
Use it with diamonds to revive them.

Controls:
- Right Click: Interact
- Shift + Left Click: Stop attacking
- Shift + Right Click: Open inventory
Inspired by §aTouhou Mystia's Izakaya§r, this system adds ingredients, dishes, drinks, and recipes.

Most ingredients come from crops or loot. Seafood is obtained via fishing.
Foods have tags that determine their effects.

-- Cooking --

Kitchenware includes: §ePot§r, §eCooking Table§r, §eFryer§r, §eGrill§r, §eSteamer§r.
All have upgraded versions.

Incorrect recipes may produce §eDark Matter§r.

Recipes support compatibility with other mods.

-- Drinks --

Most drinks are obtained from Tavern Owners.
They grant effects, and available drinks rotate daily.

Some drinks are always available.

Use a barrel on a villager to assign the Tavern Owner profession.
