reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.chat.0: Have you heard of the urban legend of the Ghost Diner?
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.chat.1: Are people these days all a bit dim-witted?
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.chat.2: Solitude is the best state to enjoy food.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.chat.3: I will never leave this place I've finally found.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.descripti: The ancient, mysterious yokai—Nue. It's a pity she looks completely different from the legends... Although she's also a disciple of Myourenji Temple, I always see her wandering aimlessly around the temple, seemingly not very sociable.

She's like an awkward child who's been ignored and tries to get attention through pranks. She longs to fit in at the temple, but clumsily doesn't know how to express it... Despite living so long, she's still so naive.

The more she cares, the more easily she shrinks back... As a result, her inner self, like her outward appearance, cannot be seen through. Is this the loneliness of "something that cannot be described"? But now she has revealed her true self, and everyone will gradually understand her frankness!
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.evaluatio: This is not something I need to reveal the truth about.
The truth is revealed just to savor this delicious treat!
Is this the truth about delicious food?!
Even the bandits of the Heian period weren't as rampant as you!
The money I've saved since the Heian period is almost gone...
It seems you haven't yet uncovered the truth about delicious food.
Anyway, I'm used to being alone.
I came here just to experience the excitement.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.order.0: In fact, humans are the animals that love the most novelty.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.order.1: You can read the scriptures slowly, but the meat must be eaten while it's hot.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.order.2: I've eaten enough rotten flesh already.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.order.3: Eating raw food is a primitive but convenient way of eating.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.order.5: Even the best signature dishes need some variation.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.order.6: Every place has its own unique cuisine.
reverie_dreams.role.houjuu_nue.order.7: Humans will take pictures of me nonstop as soon as they see me.
reverie_dreams.role.houraisan_kaguya.cha: Those who do not work do not eat; shouldn't I do something too?
Whether those five beautiful problems can be solved or not is no longer important.
I'm not a shut-in; it's just that Yonglin always has to tell me for ages before I can go out.
The rain in Gensokyo has a pH of 6, which means it's almost completely non-acidic.
The seven-colored Udumbara flower is beautiful, but the seven-colored dish tastes disgusting.
reverie_dreams.role.houraisan_kaguya.des: The princess who lives in Eientei is said to be from the moon. Why would she give up being the moon princess and become a shut-in in Gensokyo?
She appears to be an elegant princess, but her actions are actually somewhat shameless... I can understand why she became the owner of that black rabbit (the "black" refers to its heart)...

So even a noble princess has work worries just like ordinary people. Kaguya-san and I aren't so different after all. As a senior colleague with years of experience, I should definitely encourage this confused junior!
reverie_dreams.role.houraisan_kaguya.eva: This isn't something I'd go out of my way for.
How dare you serve me such filth!
With such delicious food on Earth, who would want to go back to the moon?
The delicacies are exquisite and the flavors are endless.
Is this the kind of swindling and deception that's rampant on the ground?!
Well, prices on the moon and on Earth might be different.
The food on the ground has always been good.
Suddenly I felt a loss of interest.
reverie_dreams.role.houraisan_kaguya.ord: There's a beautiful Japanese woman on the ground named Yamato Nadeshiko, and I'm quite interested in her.
Although earthly history is fleeting to me, it is an indelible past.
Most of the legends circulating on Earth were actually created and spread by the Lunarians.
This filthy yet free land always seems incredible to me.
reverie_dreams.role.hutatsuiwa_mamizou.c: Turning leaves into money is very convenient!
This style, which blends tradition and modernity, suits my taste perfectly.
Hey there... Hehehe, such a clumsy transformation won't fool this old man.
reverie_dreams.role.hutatsuiwa_mamizou.d: The leader of the tanuki demons possesses a corresponding air of authority and leadership, and is skilled in transformation magic. However, no matter how adept a demon is at transformation, it's impossible to completely hide its tail and ears. Furthermore, the size of its tail is actually a gauge of its demonic power, so perhaps it never intended to hide its tail in the first place.
reverie_dreams.role.hutatsuiwa_mamizou.e: This is a bit disappointing for an old man.
How dare you make fun of an old man like me? I'll show you what a real prank is!
This is a treat that the raccoon deserves to repay!
Hehehe—as expected of the monster I have placed my hopes on.
I'm already being very generous by not using leaves to pay!
I have plenty of leaves, but this is all the money I have.
Is this all there is to it?
How come modern monsters have forgotten even the virtue of respecting the elderly?
It's more fun to go back and drink with the tanuki.
reverie_dreams.role.hutatsuiwa_mamizou.o: How can you become strong without eating meat?
I still prefer the taste of my hometown in Sado~
Although raccoons are not cats, they also love to eat fish.
I really miss the daily life I had with humans in Sado.
Haven't the snacks to go with the drinks been prepared yet?
Humans love watching raccoons eat fruit.
There are countless legends about tanuki, aren't there?
reverie_dreams.role.huziwara_no_mokou.ch: Immortality only means an eternal, unredeemed loneliness.
If you need more charcoal, just come and ask me!
If he had a way to get to the moon, would that guy go back to the moon...?
Born from inexhaustible fire is the phoenix, which will be resurrected no matter how many times it is reborn.
reverie_dreams.role.huziwara_no_mokou.de: These are mysterious humans who live in seclusion in a bamboo forest. They have very few desires and no interest in anything the world chases. They became immortal because they ate something strange in the past (but they can't just eat anything!).

Miss Mokou is so cool! Although she's human, she's incredibly strong and has a very bold personality. It's said that people who love spicy food are very straightforward, and Miss Mokou is definitely a fan of spicy food.

She's more sensitive than I imagined, and seems to have endured unimaginable suffering in the past. Even so, she remains kind-hearted and continues to secretly help others. Someone like her is sure to find happiness!
reverie_dreams.role.huziwara_no_mokou.ev: We still need to put in more effort.
It's so hard and chewy, it must be even harder to eat than your liver!
In my long life, such delicious food is a rare find.
The evolution of the times can't keep up with the changes in your pricing!
I've always lived a frugal life, and this is all the money I have...
I think you could do better.
Oh well. I'm used to it now.
Do not do to others what you would not have them do to you.
reverie_dreams.role.huziwara_no_mokou.or: The endless smoke drifting over Monster Mountain, even without flames, was as hot as a dream.
O phoenix reborn from the ashes, may your flames of vengeance never be extinguished, never be extinguished!
The spiciness makes me feel the thrill of being alive.
Fruits can quench thirst and fill the stomach; they are a gift from heaven.
I'm actually quite good at grilling meat.
reverie_dreams.role.imaizumi_kagerou.cha: Sleeping too late is bad for your skin...
Dieting is definitely not the way to beauty.
It feels so hot even at night...
Should I get my hair cut too...?
reverie_dreams.role.imaizumi_kagerou.des: The steady and gentle wolf girl gives off a friendly, older sister vibe. Perhaps because the Moon People live in the bamboo forest, there seem to be many moon-related monsters there, and Miss Shadow Wolf is one of them.

Miss Shadow Wolf seems quite concerned about her skin; I've never seen a werewolf so vain before. The daily life of these ordinary monsters is peaceful yet lively. Sometimes I can't help but think… if I didn't run a shop, I'd probably be living a similar life.

Miss Shadow Wolf, as a wolf, is a Honshu wolf, a species that has become extinct in the outside world. Once revered and worshipped, she ultimately met a pitiful end, facing extinction. Humans and youkai of Gensokyo, please cherish us beasts (and birds)!
reverie_dreams.role.imaizumi_kagerou.eva: It seems the proprietress's cooking skills aren't very consistent.
This kind of cooking doesn't convey any kindness.
The food made by the proprietress is truly perfect!
I can taste the kindness in the food!
If only the fallen hair could be turned into money.
It's easy to overeat a late-night snack without even realizing it...
In my opinion, you should be able to do better.
Why can't we live together peacefully?
reverie_dreams.role.imaizumi_kagerou.ord: Honshu wolves naturally love Honshu-style recipes.
I prefer running in the mountains to swimming in the water.
I also really enjoy dishes that evoke a family atmosphere.
When hair grows, it needs to cool down from the stomach...
The best food is definitely for the camera first!
reverie_dreams.role.inubashiri_momizi.ch: That game of chess today was truly a worthy opponent. That's what makes it interesting!
Even without intruders, we must not let our guard down.
Everyone says that Kappa is a genius, but he is no match for me in either swordsmanship or chess.
The larger the organization, the more rules it needs.
I wonder what that tengu is up to now...
reverie_dreams.role.inubashiri_momizi.de: The white wolf tengu, who often patrols the mountain of monsters, has an extremely keen sense of smell and hearing, and is known as the mountain's all-seeing eye, able to quickly detect intruders. Because of such guardians, small monsters like us usually dare not go up the mountain.

Since there are basically no intruders on Youkai Mountain, the guards' job is very easy. After the Night Sparrow Diner opened, she seemed very happy to have another place to go in her spare time. Although she didn't show it on her face, her tail betrayed her feelings.

She was originally quite serious and methodical, but after getting to know her, I often heard her guileless complaints and occasionally saw her show a well-behaved and adorable side. She's easier to handle than I expected... If I had known this, I would have come to the mountain sooner!
reverie_dreams.role.inubashiri_momizi.ev: I should have just drunk alcohol.
Is this the kind of food you give to workers who squeeze their wallets dry?!
As expected of the cafeteria that's so popular in Gensokyo, thank you for the meal!
Delicious food can eliminate all the fatigue of the day!
This pricing is a serious violation of the order in the mountains!
The guards' wages were indeed too low; they could barely afford a meal...
It's alright to eat with alcohol.
Are we lowly mortals looked down upon even for eating?
This is not conducive to unity in the mountains!
reverie_dreams.role.inubashiri_momizi.or: Even if it becomes a monster, the wolf's nature of loving to eat meat will not change.
As the saying goes, those who live near mountains live off the mountains, and those who live near the sea live off the sea.
I just can't eat bland food; unhealthy food is just right for me.
Wine is the star of the show; if the dishes don't enhance the wine, then it's better not to eat them at all.
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.chat.0: Given Ah Kong's personality, it must be really difficult for her to keep an eye on the nuclear reactor's firepower all the time.
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.chat.1: There are quite a few vengeful spirits arriving today.
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.chat.2: Let's invite Master Jue to come next time.
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.chat.3: Has Master Jue been eating properly...?
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.descrip: The cat demon known as "Train" is the right-hand man of the Lord of the Underworld. Being able to talk to corpses and vengeful spirits seems quite convenient! However… speaking of "Train," it's all about stealing corpses. Is that why it's disliked? Hmm, it seems inappropriate to comment on other people's interests…

Think about it, when a person dies, they must be bewildered, right? If they could meet the cheerful and talkative Rin when they suddenly pass away, perhaps it would alleviate some of their fear of death.

The "ominous black cat" living under prejudice had to endure so much hardship. Prejudice is truly undesirable. Fortunately, Rin met Miss Satoru. A good owner can change a pet's life. I hope Rin can continue living a carefree life stealing corpses from now on.
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.evaluat: I'd rather eat rotten flesh, ptooey!
It's so delicious that even someone with anorexia would turn into a glutton!
Such delicious food is something you can only enjoy once in a while!
If you're forcing us to buy, don't blame us for dining and dashing!
I'm a little short on cash lately...
Could this level of food really whet Master Jue's appetite...?
Sister, you've really broken my heart.
Pride and complacency can lead to losses.
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.order.0: Rotten food breeds a lot of bacteria, so it's better to keep it fresh.
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.order.1: Desserts are the simplest and most basic culinary experience.
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.order.2: I'm so smart because I love eating fish!
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.order.3: Are the underground and the seabed actually connected?
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.order.4: Sometimes, strange things can excite cats even more!
reverie_dreams.role.kaenbyou_rin.order.5: I really want to go to that fairytale park from my dreams again.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.chat.0: The little sparrow is getting a little too close to the everyday life...
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.chat.1: My lovely subordinates are grateful for your care.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.chat.2: All the food from all corners of the world is nothing more than a bowl of earthly warmth.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.chat.3: There are many monsters that want to eat immortals, but this is the first time I've seen one cook for an immortal.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.descripti: I often see her wandering and playing around near the temple, seemingly not very enthusiastic about spiritual practice... yet she's extremely eager to convey the benefits of cultivation to others. I really can't figure out what she's thinking. She's a seemingly orthodox immortal, but her behavior and thoughts are quite unconventional.

She'll do anything to achieve her goals, regardless of the consequences, and she'll act as if it's perfectly natural even if others don't understand her actions. To say she's driven by desire seems a bit like the opposite… her actions, rather than driven by desire, might simply be a reflection of her personality.

A demonic immortal isn't necessarily an evil immortal. To be barred from the path to heaven simply because of inappropriate thought and action is truly perplexing to me… I only know that Miss Qing'e is very individualistic! If becoming a celestial being requires suppressing one's individuality, then I hope Miss Qing'e will remain as she is.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.evaluatio: If he hadn't gone mad from his cultivation, why would he be eating this kind of thing!
You have to work hard to live to be able to eat such delicious food.
It's so unromantic to be talking about fasting when faced with delicious food.
Do I look like someone who reeks of money?
Even little sparrows know how to rip off customers.
We need to work even harder!
You should think this through carefully...
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.order.0: Every dessert has a story behind it!
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.order.1: It would be too unsightly for an immortal to have a mouth full of meat.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.order.2: The portion size of a late-night snack should be small rather than large.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.order.3: My hometown is a place where Taoist priests and immortals are everywhere.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.order.4: An incredible life is what makes it interesting!
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.order.5: My story is also recorded in human legends.
reverie_dreams.role.kaku_seiga.order.6: It's so convenient to be able to enjoy food from all over the world in such a small shop.
The history of food is also very long.
I always feel that my memories of the full moon are incomplete…
An event in itself cannot be called history; only when it is recorded can it be called history.
The children seem a bit uninterested in the classes lately. Should we add more classes?
Sometimes, food carries not only the flavors of life, but also longing and memories.
A yokai who runs a private school in a human village. Hmm, I always feel like she's more human than a yokai.

Despite being a yokai, she enjoys the deep trust of humans and has amassed a great deal of faith. In the villagers' hearts, she is more reliable than a shrine maiden. It's said that she even acts as a substitute shrine maiden in the village.
Worried about both humans and demons, how admirable! Is this what a sage is? She seems to have another form, a form I shouldn't have seen before, yet I vaguely feel I've seen it before…
With more practice, you can definitely do better.
It has no taste, so it's not a pity to throw it away.
So delicious! This is a dish made with techniques that have been refined over time!
It's delicious; you must have put in a lot of effort.
This price is probably not suitable for the residents of Gensokyo.
Sorry, I'll be more careful next time.
It tastes good; I'm sure you won't stop here.
If you were my student, I'd headbutt you!
This behavior is extremely rude.
I wonder what kind of history Chinese-style dishes carry?
I wonder what kind of history Japanese cuisine carries.
Eating some vegetables occasionally makes me feel very comfortable.
I've been eating lighter meals lately...
Just some home-cooked food is fine.
History and culture complement each other.
reverie_dreams.role.kawasiro_nitori.chat: Only businesspeople with a keen sense of smell can maximize the value of business intelligence.
When you haven't decided to succeed, you've already decided to fail.
Ships are safe in the harbor, but that's not what ships are built for.
Potential customers don't care about you. They care about themselves and are unwilling to read or listen to things that don't concern them.
For industrialists, there is only one rule: make the best quality products at the lowest possible cost and pay the highest possible wages.
Shouldn't we also have some kappa (water spirits) specialize in cooking...?
reverie_dreams.role.kawasiro_nitori.desc: If all kappa are profit-driven businessmen, then she, as a minor leader, is the best of the worst! While there's nothing wrong with businessmen being profit-driven, wouldn't it be nice to have a little more humanity?

Ms. Nitori is truly brilliant; she's a genius in both business and technology! I always thought kappa were inherently profit-driven, but they're willing to spend lavishly on technology—I really don't understand them…
Her ability to seize every opportunity and turn crises into business opportunities is truly astounding. Everything I've learned from her is something I'll need a lifetime to digest!
reverie_dreams.role.kawasiro_nitori.eval: Random processing is not the addition of positive numbers, but the addition of negative numbers.
How did this cafeteria become so popular in Gensokyo? This is advertising fraud!
The service I received went far beyond the transaction itself, and I must express my gratitude!
Inviting you to open a shop in the mountains was a wise decision!
This pricing is less like doing business and more like robbery!
Although I've recently made some money, I still can't afford such high spending!
Food processing is a very complex field; you need to acquire more knowledge in this area.
This kind of business approach won't last.
Boss lady, you still don't understand how to run a business.
reverie_dreams.role.kawasiro_nitori.orde: Humans could never understand the tastes of us kappa... maybe a small number of people could.
Kappa are masters of water manipulation among monsters, and they obtain almost all their food from the water.
When entertaining us kappa, just bring out the finest dishes.
There's no fun in just drinking without any food.
You need to eat more salty food to replenish your energy.
Only the dishes with the best reputation can become signature dishes.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.chat.0: I'm not interested in boring battles.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.chat.1: The flowers also looked very happy.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.chat.2: This atmosphere has never been like this before.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.chat.3: There's wine among the flowers; why not drink alone?
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.descript: Although she appears to be an elegant lady, for some reason, many people regard her as the "Tyrant of Flowers." Despite the many terrifying legends surrounding her, no one has actually seen her bullying humans or weaker monsters. So, what kind of person is she really?

Once you see her tending to the flowers, all the rumors about her will fall apart. But I still don't understand, with such powerful demonic abilities, why would she tolerate such rampant rumors, why would she silently endure such malicious slander?

Absolutely wrong! She never "endured" those rumors because she simply didn't care. Therefore, even clarifying them became superfluous. Yuuka's greatest strength lies in her heart. I think it's not her powerful demonic energy that makes her look down on everyone; what truly makes her invincible is her pure and innocent self.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.evaluati: If treated this way, even the most easygoing flower will not be willing to bloom.
You possess the ability to make your heart bloom!
My mood is like a flower bud slowly opening.
You should be grateful I didn't leave you with a single magic cannon shot.
Asking for exorbitant prices is not a sustainable business practice.
This will not win the favor of the flowers.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.order.0: Do not touch the flowers with oily hands.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.order.1: The language of flowers is more subtle and more sophisticated than that of humans.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.order.2: The meaning of blue baby's breath is—
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.order.3: Each flower's meaning has a past that has been passed down to this day.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.order.4: Flowers that cannot leave their birthplace eventually become a local specialty.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.order.5: I quite like the social trend of valuing gentlemanly conduct.
reverie_dreams.role.kazami_yuka.order.6: The meaning of winter violet flowers is ——.
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.chat.0: A lukewarm approach will never lead to a successful revolution.
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.chat.1: Weak monsters, stand up with me!
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.chat.2: One day I will bring you under my command.
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.chat.3: Being attached to the "taste of home" is too weak!
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.descrip: A glib-tongued genie. Under the guise of turning Gensokyo upside down, he lured many hot-blooded young yokai and even humans to become his subordinates, but due to insufficient funds, he couldn't treat them well. He even hired tengu to run advertisements to scam tourists and collect tolls... No matter how you look at it, he's a reckless guy.

Does Miss Seijai really intend to overthrow her superiors? She doesn't seem interested in what would happen after a successful rebellion. Perhaps she just derives pleasure from opposing society, and doesn't genuinely want to change it.

Watching her companions leave one by one, most people would feel that this path is a dead end, right? But Miss Seija never considered giving up. In Gensokyo, where everyone is leisurely living ordinary lives, she is one of the rare types who will never give up until she achieves her goal. In a way, I quite admire her…
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.evaluat: I want to turn this world upside down—the world that treats coarse food as delicacies!
Full of power! Right now, I can turn anything upside down!
An inexhaustible source of power! Is this the power of delicious food?
Consider this tip as your protection money!
Making money by running a cafeteria is a brilliant idea!
Whose territory do you think this is?!
When will weak monsters no longer be oppressed?!
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.order.0: I have a fondness for those grotesque things that people find repulsive!
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.order.1: The bitter wine hurts my heart, so I'll eat some side dishes with it.
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.order.2: If you fried those bloated, oppressive bullies, they'd release a lot of oil.
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.order.3: Watching something sizzle and steam makes me feel great.
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.order.4: The thought of the weak overthrowing the strong fills me with excitement!
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.order.5: How would you describe something that is simply impossible?
reverie_dreams.role.kijin_seijia.order.6: To achieve my great cause, I need more power!
reverie_dreams.role.kochiya_sanae.chat.0: I have a feeling that the kappa have been acting a little unusually excited lately...
reverie_dreams.role.kochiya_sanae.chat.1: Now, I should be remembered by everyone in Gensokyo, right?
reverie_dreams.role.kochiya_sanae.chat.2: I will make the name of Moriya resound throughout Gensokyo!
reverie_dreams.role.kochiya_sanae.chat.3: Those two gentlemen are people who like to do good things but don't like to join in the fun.
reverie_dreams.role.kochiya_sanae.chat.4: Although eating late-night snacks can lead to weight gain... I've been to a lot of places today, so it should be fine!
reverie_dreams.role.kochiya_sanae.descri: A shrine maiden who suddenly appeared at the Moriya Shrine several years ago. She was said to come from the outside world, along with two deities… and a lake. It was such a bizarre event that it still feels rather frightening to this day.

Unlike the Hakurei Shrine Maiden who prefers to stay indoors and drink tea, Sanae is incredibly diligent; you can see her diligently collecting faith everywhere. Collecting faith as a human is truly remarkable; she seems like some kind of living god.

The Hakurei Shrine holds a special and absolute position in Gensokyo. Neither the Moriya Shrine nor Ms. Sanae could easily surpass the name of Hakurei. However, thanks to Ms. Sanae's diligent efforts, everyone now remembers the name of the Moriya Shrine Maiden—that's wonderful!
reverie_dreams.role.kochiya_sanae.evalua: This kind of thing cannot unite people's hearts.
Serving believers with such things will only diminish their faith!
Even I can't help but want to believe in you!
Delicious food really can collect faith!
Even if you're not an expert, this meal is way too expensive!
The cost of living in Gensokyo is even higher than in the outside world...
If you want to use this to collect faith, you'll need to refine it a bit more.
This kind of hospitality cannot foster faith.
When it comes to Japanese traditions, the Yamato style is definitely the best!
If you've never tasted the deliciousness of candy, you won't crave its flavor.
Cell phones aren't completely unusable in Gensokyo!
My home is where those two adults are.
Girls are most susceptible to dreamlike things.
Eat your fill without gaining weight, and your dreams will never be shattered.
As long as you fill your stomach, you won't feel empty!
The eccentric judges are so cool—oh my! That's me!
Waiting and waiting—what will we get in return?
reverie_dreams.role.komeiji_koishi.descr: Satori, the younger sister of the Lord of the Earth Spirit Palace, has sealed her third eye! Because she has closed her heart, her presence is very faint, and her mysterious figure has garnered her many followers underground. She always wears a bright smile, but no one knows what she truly thinks. Not even herself.
reverie_dreams.role.komeiji_koishi.evalu: My stomach is empty, but I don't want to eat.
It would look beautiful to decorate your home with little sparrows.
Such a wonderful boss lady would make my home look beautiful!
My sister said that a full belly means you're full!
Why do we have to pay for meals?
I just brought some money with me, you can take it all.
What's wrong? Can't you see me?
reverie_dreams.role.komeiji_koishi.order: I have two stomachs, one for meals and one for desserts!
There's a stimulant that tastes salty! I think it's called sweat.
Are there any special considerations when eating it raw?
Approaching the world with a sense of curiosity makes it more interesting!
You'll never guess what I want!
If the distance is too far, it won't be able to read...
Hurry up and finish eating so you can go back to work.
I finally managed to squeeze out some time, so I should treat myself.
Food is not only a sensory experience, but also a spiritual enjoyment.
reverie_dreams.role.komeiji_satori.descr: The legendary mind-reading spirit, also named Satori, is probably quite proud of its race or abilities. Because it works day and night, there's hardly any chance to talk to it…

Miss Jue is truly the most overworked lord I've ever met. Although her pets help with chores, it seems only she can handle the administrative work. She seems to have given up many of her daily hobbies for her work, but she can't give up mind-reading. Being exhausted to the point of collapse is no good.

I understand why the pets are so attached to Miss Jue. Even though she's overwhelmed with work, she still cares deeply for her sister and pets. That gentleness beneath her cool exterior is truly unforgettable.
reverie_dreams.role.komeiji_satori.evalu: I'm somewhat disappointed since I've come all this way.
This meal brought on more mental stress than any work-related stress.
It's truly a feast for the senses, with layers upon layers of delicious flavors and aromas!
Ah-Rin has always had good taste.
I know exactly how much it costs.
Sorry, I didn't have much pocket money left after giving it to my pet...
Eating is just to keep myself from collapsing.
Didn't you say you were going to prepare healthy meals for me?
A person's manners are a mirror that reflects their character.
reverie_dreams.role.komeiji_satori.order: Home-cooked meals are also a reflection of the many flavors of life.
Eating too much can impair your thinking.
The exquisite cuisine is like a real-life dream.
Food can shorten the distance between a foreign land and one's hometown.
I hope this meal will give me the strength to keep working.
reverie_dreams.role.kurodani_yamame.chat: The underground world, despised by those on Earth, is our paradise.
Although the cave is dark, my net is very bright.
The streets there have been really lively lately; I'll go there for a visit sometime.
Only by enduring the darkest darkness can we reap the brightest light.
reverie_dreams.role.kurodani_yamame.desc: A kind guide I met in the dark wind cave. She almost never goes to the village because she knows she's annoying, even though she's so cute… I really wish everyone on Earth could get to know her!
So Miss Mountain Girl is some kind of underground idol! No wonder she's like that. However, contrary to her adorable personality, her hobbies seem rather unusual…

Despite being constantly misunderstood and even perceived as "the one who is disliked," Miss Mountain Girl didn't seem to care. I could sense that she truly loved this underground world. To have such an open-minded attitude is truly remarkable.
reverie_dreams.role.kurodani_yamame.eval: I don't mean to discourage you, but the taste really wasn't very good...
They're not even as tasty as the prey caught in a spider's web.
It's amazing to be able to eat such delicious food in a dark cave!
The atmosphere and food are both perfect!
This shop is even more shady than Black Spider!
I'm not quite used to the cost of living on the ground yet...
The legendary Night Sparrow Diner must be more than this…
Even if we do nothing, will we still be disliked?
If you look down on those you dislike, don't open a shop here.
reverie_dreams.role.kurodani_yamame.orde: Life is full of sweetness and joy.
Fresh food is always the best, no matter what it is!
Would most people find spiders' tastes strange?
Take pictures of the delicious food and share them with the spiders when you get back!
I never really like eating food that's been overcooked.
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.chat.0: Don't worry, I just like to borrow books secretly; I never dine and dash.
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.chat.1: Damn it, I lost to Reimu again today!
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.chat.2: It's nice to have a meal like this once in a while, Da☆Ze!
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.chat.3: With so many people watching, I won't back out of the deal!
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.chat.4: Magic is light and heat, and cooking is pretty much the same.
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.description.0: A very cheerful and talkative human mage who lives alone in a secluded magical forest, easily getting along with humans, fairies, and monsters alike. He seems to have a deep understanding of mushrooms!
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.description.1: Although she seems to be doing nothing, she actually runs a "Misty Rain Magic Shop." Because of her collecting habits and her tendency to never organize, the shop is often mistaken for a junkyard. And, unsurprisingly, she has no customers.
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.description.2: Although she has some wicked tendencies, she is inherently upright, and it's a pleasant experience to be with her! She never wants anyone to see her efforts, but we all know... this little girl who left home at a young age to cultivate herself could rely on others more.
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.evaluation.ex: What is this thing? I might as well just swallow a mushroom raw!
Did you secretly hide some kind of magic? How can the food be so delicious!
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.evaluation.go: This dish has the potential to be the star of any banquet!
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.evaluation.la: I'll go borrow some money before I come back to eat!
I've already paid the bill. You feel there's less money in the box? That's none of my business.
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.evaluation.no: It tastes great! Can you teach me how to make it?
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.evaluation.re: Trust me! I really brought money this time!
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.order.0: You can never get tired of eating mushrooms!
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.order.1: The older something is, the more valuable it is.
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.order.3: High-calorie fried foods can make people happier~
reverie_dreams.role.marisa.order.4: Food is like magic; it's only good when it shines and generates heat!
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.chat.0: I didn't slack off—although I did sneak out.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.chat.1: Sakuya-san's throwing knives seemed to have eyes.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.chat.2: When will Miss borrow the second volume of that comic book?
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.chat.3: We need to get back before the head maid finds out.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.chat.4: It's not advisable to exercise before or after meals; taking a short nap is the best option.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.description.0: I never expected that the monster guarding the Demon's House would be such a warm and kind older sister! It's a pity she loves to sleep, and every time I try to go and chat with her, I see her dozing off.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.description.1: Miss Meiling guards this huge mansion all by herself, without even a shift. No wonder she's so sleep-deprived. I hope I can help her in any way I can.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.description.2: It turns out that Miss Meiling's hometown is on the other side of the sea. But Gensokyo doesn't have a sea, so is Miss Meiling unable to go back? Her hometown has many well-known famous dishes, and I'm trying my best to learn how to cook them for her, hoping it might ease her homesickness.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.evaluation.ba: As long as I'm full, that's fine...
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.evaluation.ex: That's outrageous! They actually tried to fob me off with something like this!
I'd be perfectly content even if my head were stabbed with knives, if I could eat dishes like this!
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.evaluation.go: This is definitely a dish I'd risk getting stabbed for to eat.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.evaluation.la: A mere security guard can't afford your food!
This is all the salary I have left…
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.evaluation.se: So this is what the landlady is like...
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.order.0: Even when you are far from home, you should never forget the taste of your motherland.
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.order.1: Are there any things like in comics that can give you a surge of power when you eat them?
reverie_dreams.role.meirin.order.3: You need to be well-fed to have the energy to work.
reverie_dreams.role.mizuhashi_parsee.cha: You stand on the bridge admiring the scenery, while someone in a building admires you.
Everyone looks so happy, I'm so jealous...
The bridge, connecting this end to the other, is symbolized as a journey from this world to the next.
Why does the food next door look so delicious? I'm so jealous...
reverie_dreams.role.mizuhashi_parsee.des: I initially thought she was a kind and cheerful yokai, but then I turned around and saw her talking badly about me behind my back… A yokai that feeds on jealousy, can't live without stirring up jealousy in others? I feel so sorry for her. But she doesn't seem to think so. Her personality is also unpredictable; it's really hard to understand.

The Bridge Princess is both a bridge spirit and a bridge guardian. Miss Parcy actually watches over others day after day as they safely travel between the surface world and the underworld... In that sense, she's quite a great spirit.

I've discovered that Miss Parcy knows everyone's strengths! Although everyone says Miss Parcy is jealous, deep down she probably admires everyone, right? It's so great to be able to understand her better!
reverie_dreams.role.mizuhashi_parsee.eva: The food at the next table is definitely better than mine!
How can someone with such terrible cooking skills open a restaurant?
It was so delicious that I even forgot about being jealous for a moment.
This kind of comforting and delicious food is truly enviable.
I'm going to nail this shady shop to a tree!
I always feel like what's in someone else's bowl tastes better...
They actually chased me away but not the other guests. I'm so jealous.
They actually chased away other guests but not me. I'm so jealous.
reverie_dreams.role.mizuhashi_parsee.ord: I can't stand the fact that other guests' food is fresher than mine!
Fruit can soothe feelings of sadness.
If you don't give me meat, I'll curse you.
reverie_dreams.role.mononobe_no_futo.cha: In the ordinary pots and pans, a person's entire life is contained.
If I could smash this plate, the shop's business would take off.
Is the fire in the kitchen hot enough? Do you need me to add some fuel to the fire?
A chef's life, spent surrounded by fire, might actually suit me quite well...
reverie_dreams.role.mononobe_no_futo.des: An ancient person who fell into a deep sleep by cursing himself for an extended period. Perhaps because he slept for too long, his way of thinking is the same as in ancient times, completely out of touch with ordinary people... He is currently trying to learn modern knowledge, but as a result, he has become even more eccentric.

If you ignore her outdated style, she actually has a rather mystical air about her, especially since she seems to know a lot about feng shui. I just don't understand... Maybe I should ask her to take a look next time I'm renovating.

The inability to completely sever ties with the past suggests a lingering attachment, doesn't it? Despite this, Miss Futo resolutely became a test subject for the Corpse-Dissolving Immortal. While I cannot comprehend this human loyalty, I deeply admire it!
reverie_dreams.role.mononobe_no_futo.eva: It can only be described as neither good nor bad.
If you're not good at controlling the heat, let me help you burn it!
No banquet in the country could surpass this!
The prices at your store could probably empty the national treasury.
I almost dined and dashed in front of everyone!
Petty people are unscrupulous and abandon the essential for the trivial!
Etiquette is the ultimate expression of humanity.
reverie_dreams.role.mononobe_no_futo.ord: It is truly fortunate that the style of my era has been able to continue to this day.
If we can't put ourselves in a sea of ​​fire, can we ignite the fire within our hearts?
The Crown Prince whom I admire is a saint who has left behind many legends.
In my time, the diet of nobles was mainly light and simple.
Taoist meat dishes often use wild game and delicacies from the mountains, and their seasonings typically consist of medicinal herbs.
A fondness for high-end goods may be a habit inherited from his time in a wealthy family...
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.chat.0: Life is a combination of magic pasta.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.chat.1: I'm tired of being nagged, so I'll just go out for a walk.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.chat.2: My books weren't just scattered around; they all stayed where they wanted to be.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.chat.3: The power of magic is actually something like science.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.chat.4: The combination of cooking and magic might be quite interesting.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.descriptio: A strange magician who always hides in the shade of a tree in her pajamas. She seems indifferent to others' opinions and uninterested in trends. Although she's very intelligent, she looks frail and weak. Being physically fit is more important than being intelligent.

Miss Patchouli always has a book in her hand. Doesn't her eyes get tired from staring at books all the time? Besides, what's said in books isn't necessarily all correct. If you just read books without going out, even if you have a lot of knowledge, you might lack some common sense.

My mentor suffers from anemia and asthma, which is really worrying (I hope it's okay to just call her that here?). Although we've known each other for so long, she's still not very friendly towards me, but she has taught me a lot, and I can't let her down.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.evaluation: Do not speak while eating or sleeping.
This is utterly unacceptable! How dare they open a shop with this level of skill?
Even with extensive reading, it's difficult to achieve such culinary skills.
How is this refreshing taste made?
Haha! Sparrow food is more precious than jade, and firewood is more valuable than cinnamon.
Cough cough, I'm not feeling well, I'll head back now...
If I could read some books, I could probably do even better.
A person who is so rude, why doesn't he just die quickly!
Hmph, rotten wood is hard to carve.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.order.0: How could someone with your bird brain understand the differences in food culture?
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.order.1: Sweetness is a flavor that can touch the heart.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.order.2: A dish that looks beautiful can make your mouth water even if it only appears in a book.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.order.3: I really want to see a dish that can transport you to a dreamlike world.
reverie_dreams.role.patchouli.order.4: To use advanced magic, one needs a high level of proficiency. The same applies to cooking.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.chat.0: After dinner, I need to buy some matsutake for Orange and some food for Master Zi...
reverie_dreams.role.ran.chat.1: I've been under a lot of stress lately, and I'm shedding more hair.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.chat.2: This smell... how did she end up here?
reverie_dreams.role.ran.chat.3: My lovely Orange is now overjoyed whenever she sees a corpse…
reverie_dreams.role.ran.description.0: The shikigami that controls the shikigami seems to be Orange's guardian. Despite being a shikigami with very strong demonic power, it always has a smiling face.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.description.1: I still can't figure out the shikigami... They have a hidden past and are connected to that Taotie Youmo? They are two people with completely different personalities.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.description.2: Wow, so that kind of thing actually happened. I think I understand a little bit about shikigami now. Miss Lan takes care of Miss Cheng and Miss Zi; she's gentle and considerate. I really hope she doesn't have to work so hard.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.evaluation.bad: Her cooking skills are about the same as Cheng's.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.evaluation.exbad: Lord Zi's cooking is better than yours!
reverie_dreams.role.ran.evaluation.exgoo: Even if I went back to the animal kingdom, I wouldn't find food that suits my taste.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.evaluation.good: No wonder Lord Zi placed his hopes on you.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.evaluation.lackm: No matter how much I calculate, I could never have imagined how heartless you, boss lady, are!
Too many people bought smartweed flowers for oranges...
reverie_dreams.role.ran.evaluation.repel: Can't I even go out and get something to eat by myself?
reverie_dreams.role.ran.evaluation.seenR: Why would Lady Zi place her hopes on this place...?
reverie_dreams.role.ran.order.0: The food served at the Yakumo family is generally of a higher standard.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.order.1: Fox spirits have created many legends in this land.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.order.2: Fried tofu is delicious, but sometimes I crave other fried foods.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.order.3: Water will get my clothes and tail wet, but I prefer the mountains.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.order.4: Foxes are an important part of Japanese culture.
reverie_dreams.role.ran.order.5: Serving Lord Murasaki is truly exhausting...
reverie_dreams.role.ran.order.6: My wisdom is such that I can even calculate the length of the Sanzu River. Isn't that incredible?
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.chat.0: Why are there more people at this shop than at a shrine, even though it's run by yokai?!
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.chat.1: Since this business is geared towards humans, I need to pay close attention to hygiene.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.chat.2: Is there any trouble today? Please let me know immediately if anything happens.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.chat.3: Watching yokai and humans eat together is a rather strange feeling for a shrine maiden.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.chat.4: This seems to be quite profitable. Should I open a store like this?
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.description.0: A poor and fierce shrine maiden... makes one wonder if she's really human? In short, be careful not to anger her.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.description.1: Reimu-san is really quite unceremonious... But without realizing it, I've received quite a bit of care from her. I'm starting to understand why so many youkai gather around her.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.description.2: The saying "a sharp tongue but a soft heart" perfectly describes Reimu. Although she seems carefree, her eyes always look straight ahead. It's wonderful that Reimu is the Hakurei Shrine Maiden.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.evaluation.bad: They didn't do much better than me.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.evaluation.exb: Are you trying to get me punished by feeding me this stuff?!
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.evaluation.exg: This meal would be worth every penny!
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.evaluation.goo: Delicious! It was worth saving up to eat here!
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.evaluation.lac: You dare to cheat me out of my money? You think you're asking for trouble?!
You never paid when you attended my family's banquets before, so you should at least give me a discount.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.evaluation.rep: Damn it, I didn't even discipline you, and you dare to kick me out?!
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.evaluation.see: I won't be responsible if I get a complaint later.
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.order.0: Sugar used to be a luxury, it's so great that we can eat it so easily now!
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.order.1: It would be too much of a waste if we didn't get enough to eat...
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.order.2: Is there any dish worthy of my title?
reverie_dreams.role.reimu.order.3: Are there any high-end dishes that don't cost a fortune...?
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.chat.1: A busy day is finally over!
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.chat.2: Now is the time to treat yourself!
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.description.0: The Moon Messenger, who seems to be very kind to me because I come from Earth, shares the same name as Reisen from Eientei. She occasionally expresses longing for the Earth; I wonder if something happened in the past… or perhaps the training for the Moon Messenger is too arduous.
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.description.1: It turns out Reisen was once a medicine-pounding rabbit who, tired of the endless task of pounding medicine, escaped to Gensokyo, where many things happened, leading her to become a Moon Messenger. No wonder she shows such attachment to the Earth. However, she doesn't seem to like her job as a Moon Messenger either; she seems to be having a very tough time, inside and out…
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.description.2: What is it like to live in constant regret? If time could turn back, would she not have run away from the work of pounding herbs? Would she have been happy then? I couldn't bring myself to ask these questions... But perhaps it's better to look forward than to dwell on the past? I hope she can find true freedom someday.
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.evaluation.ba: Is this how today just goes by...?
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.evaluation.go: Thank you, boss lady, for healing my fatigue after a long day!
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.evaluation.la: Even if you sold me, I still couldn't afford it!
The money I earned from working is almost gone...
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.evaluation.no: Thank you, I've regained my strength.
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.evaluation.se: This world is full of unfair treatment.
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.order.0: I want to try the food in places I can't reach...
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.order.2: The taste of home can soothe the fatigue of a long day.
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.order.3: If only Jinghai weren't so lifeless.
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.order.4: The moon rabbit is also a fairy. What kind of legend is this?
reverie_dreams.role.reisen.order.5: If there were mountains in Lunar Capital, what kind of animals would live there?
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.chat.0: The time spent waiting for delicious food to be ready is a happy one.
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.chat.1: The happiest time is when you're enjoying delicious food.
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.chat.2: It's about time for rain to fall, and for food to be delicious with rice.
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.chat.3: If your brain can't hold it all, then use your stomach to hold it.
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.descrip: The Hellraven that guards the ruins of the scorching hell has a fiery and cheerful personality. It looks quite different from other Hellravens, except for its empty head, which I find endearing.

The reason why A-Kong's appearance is so dazzling is because the god Yatagarasu resides within her! A hell crow born from the darkness of hell, and Yatagarasu dwelling in the sun, what a strange combination! But... is it really okay for her to have such powerful abilities?

I recently realized that no one is more suited to possess this power than Sora. To have extraordinary strength but lack the mind to use it—isn't that a kind of luck? Sora's empty head is so cute! But I'm often told I'm empty-headed too.
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.evaluat: The heat level is too low.
I'd rather throw them into the scorching hell and roast them.
I experienced a sensation more intense than the scorching heat of hell!
I'll just pretend I forgot to bring any money... I'm a slow learner anyway.
That's all the money a bird's head can hold.
Thank you for your hospitality, madam.
Watch out or I'll roast you!
Why do you have to kick people out...?
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.order.0: Meat is the source of strength; without it, life withers.
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.order.1: The fiery sensation can make you feel itchy, can't it?
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.order.3: The more oil you add, the more intense the flame will be!
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.order.4: Even if it's hotter than flames, I'm not afraid!
reverie_dreams.role.reiuji_utsuh.order.5: I have been feeling the power constantly surging within me.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.chat.1: Let's bring some back for Fran to try later.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.chat.2: The fate of this shop may have already quietly changed.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.chat.3: They're nowhere near as good as our maid.
The owner of the Scarlet Devil Mansion. From afar, she looks like a young child, but upon closer inspection, her imposing presence leaves one speechless—truly befitting a vampire lord renowned throughout the land! Yet, when she acts capriciously, she really does resemble a child…

Although she's still quite immature, she carries the fates of many on her shoulders. Despite her small shoulders, she shelters an entire family under her wings, truly embodying the role of a head of household. Miss Remy isn't entirely as self-centered as everyone thinks.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.evaluation.b: I never had any expectations of you in the first place.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.evaluation.e: You deserve to be pierced by a divine spear for making something like this, right?
Only such delicious food is worthy of a vampire's noble status!
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.evaluation.g: This time it's really good, finally something to look forward to.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.evaluation.l: Sakuya only prepared this much money for me!
I'm not used to carrying my own money when I go out...
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.evaluation.n: They're nowhere near as good as our maid.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.evaluation.r: Hmph, it seems I've been too lenient with you.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.evaluation.s: Let's just go home and eat what Sakuya makes.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.order.0: Can they make exotic dishes here?
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.order.1: Only fine cuisine is worthy of my status.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.order.2: Vampires... of course they eat raw food.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.order.3: In the past, sugar was a luxury item exclusively for the nobility.
reverie_dreams.role.remilia.order.4: The legends left behind by vampires have been unforgettable for centuries.
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.chat.0: "The night gave us black eyes," isn't that so that people could seek out the darkness?
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.chat.1: Do I look like a saint being nailed to the cross?
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.chat.2: It's too bright here; my eyes are a little uncomfortable.
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.chat.3: Lately, some people have been calling me "Third Miss." Do you know why?
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.chat.4: I even softened the darkness around me just to dine here.
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.description.0: My old friend, who likes darkness, always seems a bit scatterbrained. But I have to admit, we get along very well. Both the first and second points.
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.description.1: This girl is always wandering around, and I have no idea what she's doing. Every time I don't see her for a while, I hear new words coming out of her mouth… Where on earth has she gone?
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.description.2: The longer we know each other, the more I realize how little I know about her past. Even if I ask her, she'll just say she doesn't remember. But even so, we're still friends, and we always will be.
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.evaluation.exb: Is this what they call "dark cuisine"?
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.evaluation.exg: The meat looks absolutely radiant in your cooking!
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.evaluation.lac: Your pricing is like humans using a decimal system!
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.evaluation.rep: Why won't you let me eat it?
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.evaluation.see: Would you also try to drive me away like that?
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.order.0: Meat, meat, meat~ I want to eat meat~
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.order.1: Is the freshest way to eat it raw?
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.order.2: What humans find strange might just be perfect for me!
reverie_dreams.role.rumia.order.4: Do you have any signature dishes?
Three meals a day are regular, and four meals a day are satisfying.
Good food and beautiful scenery can combat all the sadness and confusion in the world.
After you die, you won't have to worry about anything.
When you encounter wine, just laugh it off; how long can life be!
reverie_dreams.role.soga_no_toziko.descr: The spirit of an ancient person. She seems to harbor deep resentment from the past, making her the kind of vengeful spirit that monsters fear most. I'm a little hesitant to approach her…

After actually meeting her, I found that Miss Tu Zigu's personality was indeed straightforward, open-minded, and full of energy. She didn't seem like a vengeful spirit at all. Perhaps her resentment had mostly dissipated? For someone as magnanimous as Miss Tu Zigu to become a vengeful spirit must have been an incredibly painful experience…

Unexpectedly, the culprit who turned Miss Tu Zigu into a vengeful spirit was actually Miss Budu! Yet, the two of them still seem to have a very good relationship?! Miss Tu Zigu's magnanimity goes beyond mere open-mindedness; she's probably only one step away from becoming a Buddha.
reverie_dreams.role.soga_no_toziko.evalu: It's not as good as what I make myself, even if I just mess around with it.
Are you trying to fool me with some cheap chaff?!
With such delicious food as a companion, even a thousand years of loneliness is nothing!
Such deliciousness is more unforgettable than hatred.
What a rip-off! The household allowance given by the Crown Prince is barely enough to cover the cost of a single meal?!
My money and my resentment have mostly dissipated.
Aren't you afraid I'll resent you?
The owner of the mahjong parlor is so petty...
reverie_dreams.role.soga_no_toziko.order: Let's try some of the things we've eaten in the past from time to time.
If your brain can't hold it all, then use your stomach to hold it.
When lightning strikes, you can feel a surge of power flowing from your body.
After becoming an undead, you can eat all sorts of oily and unhealthy foods!
I want to try food that looks like it's been struck by lightning.
Throughout the millennia of solitary guardianship, what I miss most is the everyday life of home.
You can tell a restaurant's style from its signature dishes.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.chat.0: There have been fewer banquets lately. It seems like something is quietly happening.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.chat.1: I know a lot about your situation, because I've been watching it closely.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.chat.2: There's a saying that goes, "It's not the wine that intoxicates, it's the person who gets drunk."
reverie_dreams.role.suika.chat.3: Drinking is only truly enjoyable in a lively setting like this.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.chat.4: You should be starting to feel the pressure in your heart by now.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.description.0: I never imagined that demons still existed in Gensokyo. I was really startled when I first saw her! But... was she really a demon?
reverie_dreams.role.suika.description.1: Without a doubt, she is a ghost. Although she usually appears small and dazed, the aura she exudes can sometimes be as imposing as a mountain. Truly worthy of being the legendary queen of the mountains.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.description.2: Demons may be a terrifying race, but once you become friends, they are the most trustworthy companions! Miss Suika may always be tipsy, but her mind is perfectly clear. That kind of carefree and unrestrained spirit is truly enviable.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.evaluation.bad: If you're eating with alcohol, you might be able to manage a couple of bites.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.evaluation.exb: Serving my wine with dishes like this is such a waste!
reverie_dreams.role.suika.evaluation.exg: I never imagined that there would be a dish in this world that I would crave even more than alcohol!
reverie_dreams.role.suika.evaluation.goo: Fine wine and delicious food, let's drink until we're drunk!
reverie_dreams.role.suika.evaluation.lac: I'm out of money. I'll treat you to a drink next time!
reverie_dreams.role.suika.evaluation.nor: Great snack to go with drinks!
reverie_dreams.role.suika.evaluation.rep: Has the ghost been gone for so long that you've forgotten how terrifying I was?
reverie_dreams.role.suika.evaluation.see: It's really boring to drive away guests at a banquet.
reverie_dreams.role.suika.order.0: Eating meat and drinking alcohol to your heart's content is what makes life truly enjoyable!
reverie_dreams.role.suika.order.1: When it comes to ghosts, it's all about Japanese style, right?
reverie_dreams.role.suika.order.2: Having some snacks to accompany your drinks is also a good idea!
reverie_dreams.role.suika.order.3: The power of the demon race is truly astounding!
reverie_dreams.role.suika.order.4: I can split into many smaller versions of myself, what kind of dishes would be suitable for that?
Can I hear good stories just by coming here?
Shining Needle City has never been this lively...
She must come here often, right?
Thank you for bringing noise and bustle to this lonely city.

A castle lord from the Totem race who greatly admires Issun-boshi (the monk from the Japanese martial arts novel series). She's a restrained and serious person, a brave fan with dreams of heroism. A sheltered princess yearning for adventure is quite a novelty. Her skill in making wagashi (Japanese sweets) perfectly matches her temperament!

He clearly yearns for the adventures of a hero and has made numerous preparations, yet he has yet to embark on his journey. He is extremely concerned about whether he can leave behind a perfect legend. Is he perhaps being a little too concerned…?

Having finally resolved her inner conflict, Miss Zhenmiaomaru bravely embarked on her journey, guided by stories of "saving the world with sheer courage." From her, I also learned that being too concerned with the outcome hinders progress; following my heart is definitely more suitable for me!
It's not even good enough to be eaten on the road.
This dish is so bad it can erode your courage!
This dish gave me the courage to embark on a journey!
This dish gave me the experience of reading a hero's tale!
Although it belonged to nobles, it was dilapidated...
Have the prices outside become this high after the Lilliputians have been in seclusion for so long?
It might be enough to stave off hunger on the road.
You actually dared to drive away the future hero?!
As a hero, I cannot allow this to happen.
The power of desserts is the power of healing.
The ancestors of the little man are descendants of the god Sukunahiko in Japanese mythology.
I enjoy listening to great stories filled with courage.
You can tell how much I eat just by looking at me.
This is a city steeped in history, yet unknown to most...
I want dishes that are beautiful and can be shared with others!
The identity of a hero is truly exhilarating!
reverie_dreams.role.tatara_kogasa.chat.0: Here I am again! Were you startled?
reverie_dreams.role.tatara_kogasa.chat.1: It's become even more lively here! I'm so happy!
reverie_dreams.role.tatara_kogasa.chat.2: Looking for a target... Alright! I'll scare that guy in a bit!
reverie_dreams.role.tatara_kogasa.chat.3: I didn't scare anyone again today...
reverie_dreams.role.tatara_kogasa.descri: The spirit residing on the strange Tang umbrella, because no one had used it, unknowingly became a spirit possessed by the spirit. It's the kind of creature that gets overjoyed and dances with glee whenever it sees someone startled.

This girl's personality is so troublesome! I thought she was a cheerful and friendly yokai, but she cries at the drop of a hat... I just can't handle these kinds of people! Luckily, she always cheers up quickly!

Although she occasionally shows a pessimistic side, deep down she's a cheerful and resolute spirit. Despite constantly encountering setbacks, she always manages to persevere in countless creative ways. I hope I can possess that kind of energy!
reverie_dreams.role.tatara_kogasa.evalua: It tasted so bad it startled me.
Wow! It's so delicious it's almost unbelievable!
It was so delicious it surprised me!
This money was given to me by the children…
It's not bad, but it lacks a bit of surprise.
I can understand that feeling of being disliked.
Isn't it interesting to have food that can give you a shock?
It feels so warm and cozy to have a family meal together.
I can't scare anyone; my stomach is always empty...
Incredibility is also a form of surprise.
I need more power to frighten humanity!
Food that looks good must taste good, right?
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.chat.0: Although it looks like a run-down little shop to me, it's not bad for a shop on the ground.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.chat.1: Those old fogies in the Heavenly Realm are so inflexible!
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.chat.2: Although the earth is not as rich as the heavens, it is still a place where one can stay for a while.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.chat.3: If a celestial being were to patronize a shop, those ignorant masses would surely flock there in droves.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.chat.4: There were quite a few strange and unusual things on the ground; although they were unconventional, they were still quite interesting.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.description.0: The legendary arrogant and disrespectful Demigod—if I could, I really wouldn't want to entertain such a guest…
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.description.1: I have to apologize for what I said earlier. How could I even consider not wanting to serve a guest? Even if she was arrogant, haughty, outspoken, utterly ignorant, and thought she was above everyone else, I still had to treat her well! I'll try my best…
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.description.2: Actually, this girl isn't so bad. Although she has a sharp tongue (very sharp), she might actually be... quite innocent. She doesn't seem to be having a very comfortable time in Heaven; it would be nice if she could release some stress on Earth.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.evaluation.ba: Hmph, for people on Earth, that's about the same level.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.evaluation.ex: They were as fierce as gnawing on a berberis and swallowing a needle!
This is exactly what I wanted! I never imagined that such a barren place could produce such delicious food!
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.evaluation.go: Such deliciousness would be no less impressive even in the heavens.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.evaluation.la: Hmph, my presence at your shop is an unparalleled honor.
Hmph, that's all this meal is worth!
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.evaluation.no: For a mere mortal like myself, I've done a pretty good job.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.evaluation.re: An ant trying to shake a tree—how laughable and overestimating its own abilities!
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.evaluation.se: Those who are petty and insignificant are not worth mentioning.
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.order.0: Stay away from meat and fish!
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.order.1: Only lowly people like you like strong flavors!
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.order.2: There's no such thing as someone who doesn't like sweet things~
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.order.3: Don't bring me cheap, unappealing items!
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.order.4: Legendary dishes, you wouldn't find them in a small, run-down shop like this, would you?
reverie_dreams.role.tenshi.order.5: Can this kind of small shop get fresh fruit?
reverie_dreams.role.watatsuki_toyohime.c: Occasionally, you should eat something other than peaches.
Eat what you like, live a lovely life.
Our fifth meal of the day has begun!
The ultimate level of a foodie is to see food and eat it.
reverie_dreams.role.watatsuki_toyohime.d: The older sister of the Watanuki family. She has a kind and gentle personality, and occasionally shows a childlike side. Apart from occasionally bringing snacks for the rabbits during the Moon Messenger's training, she hardly participates in the Moon Messenger's training, which is why she is very popular with the Moon Rabbits.

Lady Toyohime really—really likes peaches, and really—really lives a carefree life. Can someone as strong as her really live like this without having to worry about anything? To be able to live so innocently no matter the circumstances—that must be a kind of ability, right?

So, it turns out Lady Toyohime also has things she wants to accomplish. When did she first start thinking about retiring? Perhaps from the beginning, she was only forced to take on the role of leader of the Moon Messengers. The reason she hasn't retired yet is firstly because there's no suitable successor, and secondly… probably because of Lady Yorihime?
reverie_dreams.role.watatsuki_toyohime.e: If it weren't for not wanting to waste food...
It's so delicious I want to live here!
Delicious! I want to eat more and more.
Didn't I already leave the peaches behind?
Being too concerned about money will make you lose your composure.
Not wasting food is my bottom line.
The little sparrow is so naughty.
reverie_dreams.role.watatsuki_toyohime.o: I won't get cavities even if I eat a lot of sugar.
A high-quality, exquisite appearance is more likely to pique people's interest.
I've recently started to like waka poetry.
I've heard that eating grass can help with digestion?
It's so hot... It's a pity I can't use this fan to cool myself down...
I enjoy hearing the stories behind the dishes.
reverie_dreams.role.wriggle_nightbug.cha: I'm here as a neighbor to show my support, boss lady!
Don't look at me like that! My presence in the store won't affect the store's cleanliness!
The bugs near your house? That's none of my business!
For the revival of the Zerg! We now present "The Insect Announcement"—why are you telling me to shut up!
Aren't fireflies beautiful at night? Stop and watch them a little longer.
reverie_dreams.role.wriggle_nightbug.des: My old friend loves insects. Although we've known each other for a long time, I still can't stand the swarm of insects surrounding her.
This guy appears to be a firefly monster, but he's actually a descendant of a powerful ancient insect race, which is why he always acts so impressive.

I know her well. Although she seems to have a bad temper, she is actually a very considerate person to her friends! Who would have thought that such a tiny firefly would hope to use its meager light to illuminate this long-declining species in a lonely yet resolute way?
reverie_dreams.role.wriggle_nightbug.eva: How dare you treat me like this! I'll show you what a bug can do!
I've actually eaten such delicious food that I really like... I have to give back to them!
It seems you have a good understanding of Zerg tastes!
You even dared to steal Lady Riguru's money!
Consider it a favor I owe you~ Feel free to ask me for help next time!
How dare you chase away Lord Firefly?!
reverie_dreams.role.wriggle_nightbug.ord: It would be better if the dishes we ordered were a little sweet.
Raw meat always tastes better than cooked meat, right? Are you the kind of person who eats steak well-done?
I'm open to all sorts of weird and wonderful dishes made with insects!
reverie_dreams.role.yatadera_narumi.chat: The warmth and comfort of everyday life are what truly soothe the human heart.
A full stomach keeps a person from feeling empty.
Sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy are all flavors, and every meal deserves to be treated with care.
All the food from all corners of the world is nothing more than a bowl of earthly warmth.
Originally there was nothing east or west, so where is north or south?
reverie_dreams.role.yatadera_narumi.desc: Originally a Jizo statue placed in the Magic Forest, it gained life because of the forest's magic—the forest actually contains magic that can change existence itself, no wonder so many magicians live here, it's so convenient for cultivation!

I thought the Ksitigarbha statue would be more composed, but it turns out she only puts on airs when we first meet. After a few more meetings, she opens up completely. She's a very straightforward girl.
It's such a waste that he finally became a living being with his own mind, but he's still a shut-in! I have to find a way to motivate him!
reverie_dreams.role.yatadera_narumi.eval: Is this food cooked in a stinky ditch?
A bad person is like bad food; just looking at them makes me want to vomit.
How satisfying! It's better to have all five internal organs fully satisfied than to have all five aggregates empty.
It's rare for me to go out, but at least the trip wasn't in vain!
Asking Ksitigarbha for money is too shameful. Consider this meal your almsgiving.
I'll make up the difference when I come back from my next alms round.
This vegetable is suitable for survival, but not for living.
I'm not here to beg for alms; I brought money with me!
The law is equal, without any distinction of high or low.
reverie_dreams.role.yatadera_narumi.orde: He's supposed to be Ksitigarbha, so he should eat something light once in a while.
Wild animals in the mountains are not within my scope of rescue.
The depth of culinary culture may not be any less profound than that of the scriptures of Ksitigarbha.
I want to try all the different cuisines from different places, but I'm too lazy to travel.
When I was still a stone statue, the gentle breeze was the only thing on this land.
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.chat.0: Finally, I can come here with peace of mind!
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.chat.1: I was so rude before, it's so kind of the proprietress to forgive and forget.
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.chat.2: Sigh, serving Lady Yuyuko is so tiring it's making my bones feel like they're falling apart.
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.chat.3: If the proprietress needs any help, please don't hesitate to ask!
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.chat.4: If there were a canteen in the underworld, my life would be much easier.
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.description.0: She serves as the gardener, guard, and cook for the Lord of the Underworld. This means she not only has to manage the 200-yojana-wide Saigyouji garden by herself, but also protect the Saigyouji family and her master's safety, while simultaneously catering to her gluttonous master's dietary needs! Each of these is a heavy burden; hopefully, she can find some solace at the Night Sparrow Diner!
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.evaluation.bad: Wait—this shouldn't taste like this, right?
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.evaluation.exb: Even if it's a prank, this is going too far!
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.evaluation.exg: Ah—is this the taste I could never achieve no matter what I did?!
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.evaluation.goo: Waaah, I wish I could make it taste like this!
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.evaluation.lac: Grandpa always said that if you're being extorted, you should turn around and leave!
I'm sorry! This is all I can afford...
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.evaluation.nor: I should be able to do that too, right?
reverie_dreams.role.youmu.evaluation.see: Those who were kicked out are so pitiful...
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.chat.0: It's been a long time since we've gone out to eat...
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.chat.1: Now I can finally get a long sleep.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.chat.3: I've seen all your hard work.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.description.0: One of the sages who created Gensokyo, she is said to be the oldest youkai in Gensokyo. Although she is elusive and somewhat aloof, she has been secretly maintaining the safety and stability of Gensokyo all along. Although she is not understood by most people, there is probably no one who treats Gensokyo and loves it as sincerely as she does.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.evaluation.ba: This kind of thing should be thrown into the crevice.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.evaluation.ex: Such a thing doesn't even qualify to stay in the gap.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.evaluation.go: Indeed, no wonder it enjoys such a great reputation.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.evaluation.la: I cannot allow such exorbitant pricing to exist in Gensokyo!
The little sparrow's business acumen has gone a little too far.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.evaluation.no: It seems to be different from what I imagined.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.evaluation.re: Shall we come to the gap to talk?
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.evaluation.se: This is not the Gensokyo I envisioned.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.order.0: A sense of sophistication is an experience that makes people feel a high level of quality.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.order.1: Home is a place where you can get a good night's sleep.
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.order.3: Have you ever heard of the saying "soup nourishes the body"?
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.order.4: What's so strange about my little gap?
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.order.5: It's so cool under the umbrella!
reverie_dreams.role.yukari.order.6: The presentation of food is also very important.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.chat.0: I couldn't forget the taste from my dream, so I came here.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.chat.1: Hmm, there are a lot of tiny sparrow bones...
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.chat.2: Is it really a shame that the owner of this shop can't eat?
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.chat.3: Don't be nervous, just treat me like a regular guest.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.chat.4: I feel embarrassed when someone stares at me so warily while I'm eating.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.description.0: That horrible creature almost devoured Gensokyo. I thought world peace would come once it regained its senses, but the first thing it did was try to eat me?! Now it occasionally eats in the cafeteria, and sometimes it looks at me and drools... I never want to see that ghost again in my life.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.evaluation.ba: Hmm, this isn't the taste I remember.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.evaluation.ex: This doesn't even look as appetizing as the owner's food.
This is the taste I can't forget!
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.evaluation.go: It's true that you need to go out and eat good food every now and then.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.evaluation.la: Oh dear, I forgot to bring any money.
Are we ready to pay? Let me see, this should be enough.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.evaluation.no: It didn't taste quite like what I remembered.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.evaluation.re: I won't eat your shop out of business.
reverie_dreams.role.yuyuko.evaluation.se: Huh? That little sparrow is so boring…
